caption: Hands shape a lump of clay-like bread dough into a smooth, round boule on a wooden table.
conditions: first frame, caption, existing requirements; no future target
physical_dependency_analysis:
OBSERVED: Dough is soft, hands press symmetrically, surface lightly floured, shape is evolving toward roundness.

INTERACTION: Pressure from hands → dough deforms plastically; flour → reduces friction → enables smooth surface formation.

PERSISTENCE: Continuous hand pressure sustains deformation; flour layer persists to prevent adhesion; dough’s elasticity propagates shape uniformity.

INTERVENTION: If pressure becomes uneven → shape asymmetry; if flour depleted → dough sticks → surface becomes rough; if dough stiffens → deformation slows.
